name: partial-cleanup
title: Partial cleanup after multiple acquisitions
fix_goal: When a function acquires several resources, cleanup must account for every resource independently.
fix_steps: List each acquired resource: file descriptor, pipe read end, pipe write end, heap buffer.
Initialize each descriptor to -1 and each pointer to NULL.
Release each owned resource in one cleanup block.
Clear each ownership marker after release.
Re-run ./lab.sh and confirm both descriptor and allocation findings disappear.
lesson: Functions that acquire several resources need a cleanup ledger, not a cleanup guess.
